key_insight: AAbAAC is a small, manually annotated PubMed corpus designed to improve information extraction for autoimmunity by identifying diseases, autoantibodies, targets, body locations, and clinical signs.
clinical_relevance: Better extraction of autoimmunity concepts from biomedical text could support research workflows, literature curation, and downstream knowledge discovery in this specialized field.
method: Built a corpus of 115 PubMed abstracts with manual entity and relationship annotations.
Evaluated multiple named entity recognition methods on the autoimmunity task.
Fine-tuned NER models to test whether domain-specific training improves performance.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports that fine-tuning on AAbAAC improved NER performance, supporting the value of the annotated dataset for this domain.
watch_item: Because the corpus is relatively small and domain-specific, results may not transfer well to broader biomedical settings or unseen autoimmunity subtopics.
paper_title: AAbAAC: An Annotated Corpus for Autoimmunity Information Extraction
